name: Slam Neon
tagline: Shenghua's kinetic short: dark stage, one neon accent, giant slams with shake and flash.

motion.direction: Shenghua kinetic short. A new shot lands on each spoken line: giant uppercase slam words (2–4 words per line, 150–220 px, the key word in `ter`), a counter or year roll on every number, `strikeLine` drawn through the wrong idea, a `stamp` verdict (NOT READY / SCAM / TRUE) on judgement words, tilted `imageCard`s as taped polaroids with a typed label, `chips` for lists. Cut every 1–4 s; any hold over 4 s needs a punch-in (`zoom`). Keep the speaker's face for the opening and closing lines (full mode), animate everything between. Hard cuts only; no serif lines, no patterns, no film strips.
